# LectoClub

> LectoClub is a mobile app (iOS and Android) that turns the physical books members already own into a shared library for a club: a school class, a reading group or a bookshop's reading club. It is made by ArnoHealth S.L. (onmedic), Barcelona.

- Members register physical copies (by ISBN or by hand) and choose which clubs to share them with. Each copy is separate.
- Loans with due dates, renewals and waiting lists; QR bookplates; reading diary and an end-of-year reading certificate for children.
- Reading groups: polls for the next book, meetings and chapter read-alongs where each section's discussion opens only when you reach it.
- Bookshop clubs: the bookshop picks the club book, opens discussion topics (with spoiler warnings) and links to its shop; lending between members is off.
- Children have no accounts: they are profiles managed by a responsible adult. No ads, data stored in the EU.
- Pricing: free plan (1 club, 15 members, 150 books); Club plan €59.99/year or €6.99/month, paid by the organiser, free for every member; Personal plan €24.99/year or €2.99/month.
- LectoClub does not sell, lend out or distribute books itself.
